The '''''Redclaw''''' was a [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessel]] that served the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. It carried several [[Venom assault squad]]s, including [[Redclaw Venom One]].<ref name="LECG" />
